title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Strictly Implementing the Standards for Level Jurisdiction over First-Instance Civil and Commercial Dispute Cases Accepted by High People's Courts
keywords_en: court accepts first-instance civil and commercial disputes
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Strictly Implementing the Standards for the Level Jurisdiction of First Instance Civil and Commercial Dispute Cases Accepted by High People's Courts

Fa [2002] No. 23

The High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Recently, it has been discovered that a small number of High People's Courts, when accepting first-instance civil and commercial cases, have violated the provisions of our Court's Fa Fa [1999] No. 11, the "Notice on the Standards for the Level Jurisdiction of First Instance Civil and Economic Dispute Cases Accepted by High People's Courts" (hereinafter referred to as the "Notice"), by accepting cases where the amount of the subject matter in dispute is significantly lower than the prescribed standards. This has led to an increase in the number of cases appealed to our Court, affecting the efficiency of case handling and the supervision and guidance over the trial work of lower courts. Therefore, our Court hereby reiterates that all High People's Courts shall strictly implement the above-mentioned "Notice," and any practices that do not comply with the "Notice" in accepting cases shall be immediately corrected. For cases that continue to be accepted not in accordance with the "Notice," our Court will remand them for retrial.

It is hereby notified.

February 1, 2002
